name: MD Lab VR
description: Build and run a molecular-dynamics simulation in virtual reality. Pick neon, argon, krypton or xenon, build a crystal or a gas, then heat, squeeze and pull atoms with controller tweezers while T, P, energy, g(r) and diffusion update live. Seven guided lab tasks (melting, diffusion, Boyle's law, condensation…). Runs on a Meta Quest headset – standalone in the Quest browser, or on a PC through SteamVR/OpenXR – and on the desktop with a mouse.
